appName.message: Kihifadhi Data — Zuia Matangazo, Picha na Video

appDesc.message: Okoa data kwa kuzuia matangazo, picha na video zinazojicheza. Imetengenezwa kwa muunganisho wa polepole au wenye kikomo.

cmdToggleSite.message: Simamisha au endelea kuzuia kwenye tovuti hii

popupTagline.message: Inazuia matangazo, picha na video za kujicheza

savingsEmpty.message: Vinjari kidogo, akiba yako itaonekana hapa

reviewTitle.description: Heading of the in-popup review prompt. Uses the same product name as popupTitle.

reviewBody.message: Umezuia maombi $COUNT$ hadi sasa. Ukadiriaji mfupi husaidia wengine wenye data finyu kuipata.
reviewBody.description: Body of the review prompt. $COUNT$ is the exact number of blocked requests, already formatted for the locale.

reviewRate.description: Button that opens the Chrome Web Store review page.

reviewLater.description: Button that dismisses the review prompt. Only two dismissals are ever offered.

dashOpen.message: Kanuni za kila tovuti na historia
dashOpen.description: Link at the bottom of the popup that opens the dashboard.

pillBlocking.message: Imezuiwa hapa — bofya kuruhusu kwenye tovuti hii
pillBlocking.description: Tooltip on a per-site pill that is currently blocking.

pillAllowing.message: Imeruhusiwa hapa — bofya kuzuia kwenye tovuti hii
pillAllowing.description: Tooltip on a per-site pill that is currently allowing.
